script.title: Inference Radar — 2026-07-05
script.intro: VLLM and SGLang see multiple PRs for model support and performance.

slides.heading: vLLM
bullets: Voxtral Realtime — fixes token feedback task timeout (#44461)
Mamba/Mamba2 — fixes loading checkpoint without architectures field (#46037)
slides.narration: Three landings on vLLM. Voxtral Realtime fixes a bug where the token feedback task would timeout. Mamba and Mamba2 checkpoints can now be loaded without an architectures field. Sequence Parallelism adds support without needing data parallelism, resulting in a 1.9% end-to-end throughput improvement.

slides.heading: SGLang
bullets: Metal RMSNorm kernel — at parity or better than mx.fast.rms_norm (#30163)
Fast Recovery Framework — reduces engine restart time to < 10 seconds (#27139)
slides.narration: Two key updates in SGLang. A custom Metal RMSNorm kernel is now available, offering performance at or better than the existing mx.fast.rms_norm implementation. Additionally, the Fast Recovery Framework significantly reduces engine restart time to under 10 seconds.

slides.heading: Megatron
bullets: MoE: Fix memory leak in full recompute mode (#5197)
slides.narration: Megatron sees two important fixes. One addresses a memory leak issue in MoE architecture with full recomputation, and the other resolves a crash in Torch FSDP2.

slides.heading: TRT-LLM
bullets: Mamba SSD HAS_INITSTATES=True kernels warmup — 3.36% total token throughput improvement (#15876)
Qwen-Image-Layered FP8 support — includes SageAttention and Cache-DiT integration (#15096)
slides.narration: TRT-LLM introduces performance enhancements. Pre-JITing certain kernels during warmup improves total token throughput by 3.36%. Additionally, Qwen-Image-Layered FP8 support has been added, featuring SageAttention and Cache-DiT integration.

slides.heading: Picks
bullets: D4 · SGLang #30162 · b200 · Gemma4 vision-prefill collapses at low concurrency with max_soft_tokens=11
D4 · vLLM #47648 · deepseek · DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark fails on H200/SM90 with FlashMLA KV cache shape
slides.narration: Two notable open issues. One in SGLang where Gemma4 vision-prefill collapses under specific conditions, and another in vLLM where DeepSeek-V4-Flash-DSpark fails on certain hardware configurations.

script.outro: That's all for today's Inference Radar.

recent_prs.title: fix(moe): free activations immediately in full recompute mode
recent_prs.one_line_summary: MoE: Fix memory leak in full recompute mode
recent_prs.technical_summary: The PR fixes a memory leak issue in MoE architecture with full recomputation by explicitly deleting intermediate tensor references after building the final output tensor. This allows the CUDA caching allocator to reclaim memory immediately during the same training step. The fix is implemented in moe_utils.py.
recent_prs.reasoning: The strongest signal from the title and body is the mention of 'moe' and 'full recompute mode', which indicates that the primary category is 'moe'.

recent_prs.title: [Apple Silicon] Add a custom Metal RMSNorm kernel
recent_prs.technical_summary: This PR adds a custom Metal RMSNorm kernel for Apple Silicon, which is at parity or better than the existing mx.fast.rms_norm implementation. The kernel is off by default and can be enabled with an environment variable.
recent_prs.reasoning: The strongest signal is the addition of a custom Metal RMSNorm kernel, which falls under the attention category.

recent_prs.title: [FEAT] Fast Recovery
recent_prs.technical_summary: This PR proposes a Fast Recovery Framework to reduce engine restart time to < 10 seconds. The framework includes a weight cache daemon, CUDA graph serialization, kernel warmup optimization, and server initialization optimization.
recent_prs.reasoning: The strongest signal is the proposal of a Fast Recovery Framework, which falls under the perf_eng_mrv2 category.

recent_prs.title: [Tests] Add parallel sampling coverage for LLMEngine.add_request()/step() (#21948)
recent_prs.technical_summary: Added parallel sampling coverage for LLMEngine.add_request()/step() to ensure correct behavior for different output kinds. The test exercises parallel sampling directly through LLMEngine for every output kind. The test also verifies that the engine never finishes all child requests and that the finished set is equal to the set of range(n).
recent_prs.reasoning: I picked model_support as the primary category because the PR is adding test coverage for LLMEngine, which is a model-related component.

recent_prs.title: [minimax-m3] Split 4/4: model + VL + glue + function-call + fp8 quant + generic infra
recent_prs.technical_summary: This PR integrates the MiniMax-M3 model, including VL, glue, function-call, and fp8 quantization changes. The PR also includes generic MoE infra changes and depends on three other PRs.
recent_prs.reasoning: The strongest signal is the integration of the MiniMax-M3 model, which falls under the model_support category.

recent_prs.title: [Gemma4] Support per-request max_soft_tokens (image resolution) via images_config and mm_processor_kwargs
recent_prs.technical_summary: This PR adds support for per-request max_soft_tokens (image resolution) via images_config and mm_processor_kwargs for Gemma 4. The change is additive and backward-compatible.
recent_prs.reasoning: The strongest signal is the addition of support for per-request max_soft_tokens, which falls under the model_support category.

recent_prs.title: Warn when TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST PTX is ignored
recent_prs.technical_summary: Warn when TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST contains +PTX entries that vLLM does not preserve in global CUDA arch extraction. The existing per-kernel CUDA arch selection behavior remains unchanged.
recent_prs.reasoning: I picked torch_compile as the primary category because the PR is related to CUDA arch extraction and TORCH_CUDA_ARCH_LIST, which is a torch-related configuration.

recent_prs.title: [XPU] fix transformers version for xpu platform
recent_prs.technical_summary: Fixed transformers version for XPU platform.
recent_prs.reasoning: I picked model_support as the primary category because the PR is fixing an issue related to a specific model (transformers) on a particular platform (XPU).

recent_prs.title: [XPU] Unbreak stage-b: re-add --disable-decode-cuda-graph, quarantine EAGLE3 parity
recent_prs.technical_summary: This PR re-adds the --disable-decode-cuda-graph flag to prevent stage-b from timing out due to the lack of SYCL Graph extension support for sycl_ext_oneapi_work_group_scratch_memory. The flash-attn kernel uses this feature, causing the test to fail. The PR is a temporary fix until the real issue is addressed in sgl-kernel-xpu.
recent_prs.reasoning: The PR is primarily related to attention kernels, as it deals with the flash-attn kernel and its compatibility with the SYCL Graph extension.
